person_reference.image_depiction: ドリブルで踏み込むプレー姿のイラスト。特定試合の実際の場面の再現ではない。選手名・背番号・出場や個人成績の主張なし。

brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story / editorial sports thumbnail.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball article thumbnail as a PNG, landscape 1600×900 (16:9), opaque background.
Style: approved バスケまとめ visual language: near-black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B dry-brush diagonals, warm ivory bold Japanese typography, hand-drawn ink and brush hatching, sparse composition and strong small-size legibility. This is an illustration, clearly not a photo.
Subject: ONE real basketball player, Shuki Shigetomi / 重冨周希, selected randomly from the article's listed players. Depict his likeness as seen in the official B.LEAGUE 2026-27 portrait, never a generic fictional substitute: Japanese adult male, athletic compact guard build, clean-shaven, oval face with broad soft cheek contours tapering to a rounded chin, medium straight nose, narrow smiling almond eyes, dark nearly straight brows, medium-full lips, short black wavy hair parted off-center with raised tousled volume and curled locks at the temples, forehead visible, sides shorter. Draw the face recognizably and naturally in expressive pen-and-ink, with a focused playing expression. No beard, no headband, no invented tattoos.
Pose: right half of frame, dynamic low driving stance, torso leaning diagonally forward, face in readable three-quarter view toward the left. His right hand is in contact with the top of a single orange basketball at hip level during a dribbling drive; left arm naturally bent for balance. Show two anatomically plausible arms and correct hands. Compose from head to knees, hands, face and ball fully inside the canvas. Plain ivory/black sleeveless basketball uniform; no lettering, numbers, emblems or sponsors. Lime brush strokes emphasize movement behind him. This is a conceptual playing illustration, NOT a reconstruction of a particular match, decisive play, score or achievement.
Text area: left 57% of frame with large clean generous margins. Main headline in very heavy Japanese gothic, warm white and lime, never obscured by the player. At least 50px safe margins at all edges, keep footer fully readable.
Render ONLY the following exact text, no other text:
Top small: "バスケまとめ"
Date small beneath: "2026.11.21"
Main very large two lines: "試合結果" and "当日のEFF"
Secondary: "B.ONE / B.NEXT"
Qualifier in a distinct clean lower-left band, readable and subordinate to headline, two lines: "B.ONE 全試合の公式記録確定待ち" and "19:05時点"
Footer: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "イメージ"
Source meaning: frozen article as of 2026-11-21 19:05 JST includes B.ONE and B.NEXT results, B.NEXT positional EFF tables, while B.ONE full official records and its EFF standings are still pending. Do not imply every match or ranking is final.
Do not put the player's name, team name, jersey number, individual stats, performance or attendance claim anywhere in the image. Do not carry over Culver's name, 38 points, or Sendai/Kobe scores from the approved style reference. Do not include any team or league logo, official photo, watermark, realistic photography, extra people or extra basketballs. Use generic text typesetting for B.ONE / B.NEXT, not league logotypes. Clear editorial hierarchy, excellent Japanese typography, no cropping of text.

SINGLE CORRECTION
Edit the FIRST image (the generated black/lime basketball thumbnail). The SECOND image is an official portrait of the actual player Shuki Shigetomi / 重冨周希, provided ONLY as a face and hair likeness reference; do not paste, reproduce, or composite the photograph itself.
This is the single permitted correction. Keep all Japanese text EXACTLY as it currently appears, preserve the 1672×941 landscape canvas, headline arrangement, colors, paper-and-ink brush style, generic unbranded uniform, body pose, ball and hands.
Correct the illustrated player's identity to match the SECOND portrait: his face has softer fuller cheeks, a longer oval contour tapering smoothly to a rounded chin, narrow almond-shaped eyes, nearly straight relatively thin eyebrows (not the thick sharply angled brows in the current illustration), a natural medium nose, fuller lips and recognizable facial proportions. He is completely CLEAN SHAVEN: remove all moustache marks and beard/stubble at the upper lip, lower lip, chin and jaw. Preserve natural pen-and-ink contour shading without depicting facial hair. Match the official portrait's wavy parted black hair with less exaggerated volume; short sides, open forehead and loose locks either side. Retain a focused playing expression but allow his softer facial features to remain recognizable. No generic heroic comic-book face. Draw him as a hand-inked illustration, not a photo.
Also reduce/reposition the head slightly so the entire hair silhouette sits at least 30px below the top border, without covering any text. Keep the rest of the thumbnail unchanged.
Do not add the player's name or jersey number anywhere. No logos, official photographs, extra people, new text, or invented achievements. Maintain the existing annotations “イラスト（AI生成）” and “イメージ”.
